title: fix(plugin-charts): advanced chart axis ticks use the muted foreground
body:
Fixes #13129
Clause-②: no

## What

`AdvancedChartImpl` passed no `tick` to any axis it draws, so recharts painted every tick label in the axis `stroke` default, `#666` (about 3:1 on a dark card). Every axis the advanced chart draws now takes one shared tick style, `AXIS_TICK_STYLE = { fill: 'hsl(var(--muted-foreground))' }`, the same fill `ChartImpl.tsx` uses:

- the category x axis, through `xAxisCommonProps` (used by the combo branch and the vertical cartesian branch);
- the combo's two value `YAxis`;
- the horizontal-bar branch's value `XAxis` (single and dual) and its category `YAxis`;
- the vertical cartesian branch's value `YAxis` (single and dual);
- scatter's `XAxis` and `YAxis`;
- radar's `PolarAngleAxis` and `PolarRadiusAxis`.

Only the fill is set; the font size stays the container's `text-xs`, and every other tick prop is unchanged.

Mechanism, measured in the rendered DOM: `ChartContainer` already carries `[&_.recharts-cartesian-axis-tick_text]:fill-muted-foreground`, but recharts 3 draws tick text under `g.recharts-cartesian-axis-tick-label` (in a separate z-index layer), while `g.recharts-cartesian-axis-tick` now holds only the tick `line`s. That selector matches no text, which is why the computed fill was `#666`. Polar axes match neither.

## Tests (at HEAD 6ab7bd8720)

- New pin `packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.axisTickFill-13129.test.tsx`: for bar, line, area, bar with two value axes, horizontal-bar (single and dual), combo, scatter and radar, it counts the drawn axes and asserts every tick `text` of each axis has `fill="hsl(var(--muted-foreground))"` and not `#666`. Result: 9 passed (9).
- Ablation (via `ablation-replace.mjs`, wrap mode): anchor `const AXIS_TICK_STYLE = { fill: 'hsl(var(--muted-foreground))' };` replaced with `const AXIS_TICK_STYLE = undefined;` (anchor x1 to x0, blob e5b9d2f782d6 to 9f9f650ede13). Result: 9 failed (9), for example `recharts-xAxis-tick-labels#0 tick fill: expected '#666' not to be '#666'`, and `angleAxis#0 tick fill: expected '#808080' ...` on radar. Restore: blob after restore e5b9d2f782d6 equals the blob at HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- All 30 `AdvancedChartImpl.*` test files: 544 passed. The 29 other plugin-charts test files that name `AdvancedChartImpl`: 497 passed. The 4 plugin-dashboard tests that read tick DOM: 68 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-charts type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; the test config includes `src/**/*.test.tsx`), after building the `@object-ui/plugin-charts^...` closure: exit 0.
- eslint, narrowed to the 2 changed source files: 0 errors (the json output counts 2 files). The config sets no `parserOptions.project`, so type-aware linting is off and this diff cannot change the result for any file it does not touch.
- `check:` phantom-deps, self-import, unreferenced-sources, doc-example-readers, handler-key-reads, side-effects-array, element-data-source-declaration, spec-symbols, action-forward-parity, designer-field-key-parity, icon-record-names, i18n-keys, i18n-drift, i18n-designer-parity, control-bytes, new-line-citations; `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs`: all exit 0.
- The full `packages/plugin-charts/` directory is left to CI.

## Changeset

`.changeset/13129-chart-axis-ticks.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-charts` patch.

## Acceptance notes

- The `[&_.recharts-cartesian-axis-tick_text]:fill-muted-foreground` class on `ChartContainer` (`ChartContainerImpl.tsx`) matches nothing under recharts 3, for the reason above. It is now redundant for the advanced chart and was already dead. Not filed: it is dead code with no user-visible effect once the tick prop is set. Whoever next edits `ChartContainerImpl.tsx` can drop it or retarget it to `.recharts-cartesian-axis-tick-label`. Nobody has picked it up.
- `ChartImpl.tsx` restates the same fill object on each of its axes. Left as is; it is outside this card's file surface.
